Saturn in natal Moon sign — maximum karmic load, transformation
Saturn moves to sign after natal Moon — gradual relief, rebuilding

TARA_DESC: Birth star — strong but sensitive, proceed with caution
Prosperity star — excellent for financial and business activities
Danger star — avoid all important works, travel, investments
Comfort star — good for routine activities, family matters
Obstruction star — delays and obstacles in all directions
Achievement star — favorable for spiritual and career progress
Destruction star — very inauspicious, absolutely avoid new starts
Friend star — favorable for social activities and agreements
Supreme Friend star — most auspicious, begin anything important
